predeclaredAssessment.primary: Both B attempts must complete hop index2 and complete strictly more hops than their adjacent paired A (A1/B1 and B2/A2), unless both arms complete the full route; in that case both pairs must have lower B route wall time.
predeclaredAssessment.mechanism: First cold prefix no scout/hint; warm fully cached siblings no hint; later fetchable prefix miss at most1 hint/request. Fewer serial source reads for the expanded prefix. If A and B both complete hop index2, B must have lower hop2 wall time in both pairs.
